children.name: A project team needs to show how processing tomato
children.text: A project team needs to show how processing tomatoes and solar generation could share one Central Valley plot. The room wants specifics.

children.name: A benchmark could not answer a site question.
children.text: A benchmark could not answer a site question.

children.name: The deck showed category-level water and yield cla
children.text: The deck showed category-level water and yield claims. The landowner asked what happened when row spacing widened for farm equipment.

children.name: That question changes shade, panel density, crop r
children.text: That question changes shade, panel density, crop response, and energy at once. A static slide could only promise a follow-up.

children.name: Put the trade-off where everyone can see it.
children.text: Put the trade-off where everyone can see it.

children.name: The team sets the plot, crop, clearance, and spaci
children.text: The team sets the plot, crop, clearance, and spacing. Four outputs move from the same inputs.

children.text: Illustrative modeled estimate. Values use demonstration coefficients, not measured field performance.

children.text: The modeled result is not the final answer. It is a shared, inspectable starting point for the decision.

children.text: Walk through the model with the people who need to trust the result.
